The [PDF](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-FS-W_EUDI_Wallet_Functional_Certification_-_Wallet_Solution_Conformance_RC1.0_20261106.pdf) is authoritative: each requirement links to the page it is on. You can also read the [full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-fs-w) or [search all requirements](/edi-stelsel/requirements).

**37 entries:** 37 iCS statements. **Obligation:** 14 recommended, 12 optional, 11 mandatory.

**Legal basis of the document:** [eIDAS Art. 5a](/edi-stelsel/legal-basis#eu-910-2014), [CIR 2024/2977](/edi-stelsel/legal-basis#eu-2024-2977), [CIR 2024/2979](/edi-stelsel/legal-basis#eu-2024-2979), [CIR 2024/2981 Annex III](/edi-stelsel/legal-basis#eu-2024-2981), [CIR 2024/2982](/edi-stelsel/legal-basis#eu-2024-2982).
